gaps.sentence: ___ it not been for the lifeguard, the boy would have drowned.
gaps.explanation: 'Had it not been for …' = 'If it had not been for …'.

gaps.sentence: ___ I known about the change of plan, I would have waited.
gaps.explanation: 'Had I known …' = 'If I had known …' — inverted third conditional.

gaps.sentence: Never before that afternoon ___ so many goals been scored in one match.
gaps.explanation: 'Never before that afternoon' fixes the reference in the past: had so many goals been scored.

gaps.sentence: At no point ___ the pilot leave the cockpit.
gaps.explanation: At no point did… = never did… — negative adverbial inversion.

gaps.sentence: Should the temperature ___ 40 degrees, the system shuts down.
gaps.explanation: Should the temperature exceed… = if it exceeds… — technical register.

gaps.sentence: Nowhere ___ the report mention the missing funds.
gaps.explanation: Nowhere does the report mention… — present simple inversion.

gaps.sentence: On no account ___ passengers open this door.
gaps.explanation: On no account should passengers… — formal prohibition.

gaps.sentence: Only after the audit ___ the missing funds come to light.
gaps.explanation: 'Only after the audit did the funds come to light'.
